tools.name: recognize_account
tools.description: Say which TrueRent account this sign-in is linked to. Returns the company name and account number. Does not read equipment, prices, invoices, or orders. Does not send anything. Requires a TrueRent sign-in issued for this plugin.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "how_truerent_works" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: TrueRent helps companies get more value out of the way they already rent equipment. We start by learning how you rent today. We don't tell you what to rent or w…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_follow_up · Private data: request_follow_up · Public sink: request_follow_up, place_equipment_order, recognize_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_follow_up · Private data: request_follow_up · Public sink: request_follow_up, place_equipment_order, recognize_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
